title: Protect: empty workflow-run discovery must retry, then fail closed
answers: Protect passed before the MLflow tests finished
PR merged on DCO alone while workflow tests were still pending
why does Protect fail with 'No workflow runs found... Rerun this job'
body:
Symptom: Protect reports success and lets a PR proceed on the DCO check alone while the workflow tests are still running, because workflow discovery returned no runs.
Root cause: .github/workflows/protect.js:module.exports treated one empty filtered result from github.rest.actions.listWorkflowRunsForRepo (head_sha = ref) as 'no Actions checks expected'.
Fix pattern: Re-run the same paginated listing and the same filters (protect.yml self-exclusion, event !== 'dynamic', IGNORED_WORKFLOWS) up to 3 times, sleeping 5000 ms between attempts and calling core.warning per empty attempt. If still empty, throw an Error asking for a job rerun. Leave latest-rerun dedup and failure detection unchanged.
Constraints: An empty response does not prove that no checks are expected, so the code fails closed. A PR whose SHA genuinely has no expected workflow runs will also fail after the retries (about 10 s). The diff throws here, which differs from protect-js-expected-protect-failures-are-reported-with-core (core.setFailed); that conflict is flagged, not resolved.
applies: Applies to the workflow-run discovery step in .github/workflows/protect.js; does not cover the check-run or status polling loop.
says: Pull request protection passed and allowed merging while test workflows were still pending.
Merge gate reports success prematurely when automated test suites have not finished running.
Pull request check failed asking to rerun because no workflow runs were detected.
Prevent pull requests from merging when required validation checks fail to appear immediately.
search: Workflow-run discovery in .github/workflows/protect.js must retry empty listing results up to three times with a 5000 ms sleep before failing closed. Applies to listWorkflowRunsForRepo filtering using protect.yml self-exclusion, event !== 'dynamic', and IGNORED_WORKFLOWS, throwing an Error if still empty after retries. Does not cover check-run polling, leaves dedup unchanged, and notes a conflict where it throws instead of calling core.setFailed.
